sentences.text: Shri S.K.Meena - Advocate for the appellants.

Shri Bhuwan Gautam - Government Ad
 respondent/State.
Heard on I.A.No. 1690/2025 Appellant No.2 - Kendar Singh has filed the present application under Section 430 of the BNSS for suspension of remaining jail sentence and grant of bail.

2. Appellant has been convicted for offence punishable under Sections 341, 323, 366 & 376 (D) of the IPC and sentenced to undergo 1 Month R.I. and fine of Rs.500/-, 1 Year R.I. and fine of Rs.1000/-, 10 Years R.I. and fine of Rs.25,000/- and Life Imprisonment with fine of Rs.25000/-
respectively with default stipulation.

3. Learned counsel for the appellant submits that the trial Court without appreciating the evidence wrongly found the appellants guilty for the aforesaid offences only on the basis of evidence of prosecutrix while statement of the prosecutrix is not trustworthy.
There are so many contradictions in her cross-examination which shows that she has falsely implicated the appellant.
Appellant has completed more than 8 years in custody.
Further, the co-accused Karamsingh has been granted bail by this Court vide order dated 16.01.2025.
Hence, counsel prayed for grant of 2 CRA-2871-2018 suspension of jail sentence to the present appellant on the ground of parity.
4. Learned counsel appearing for the State has vehemently opposed the prayer.

5. Considering the facts and circumstances of the case and arguments advanced by learned counsel for the parties and on the ground of parity without commenting on the merits of the case, this Court is of the considered opinion that the application for suspension of custodial sentence filed on behalf of the appellant deserves to be allowed.
6. Accordingly, I.A.No.1690/2025 is allowed and the execution of remaining jail sentence of the appellant - Kendar Singh is hereby suspended till the final disposal of this appeal.

It is directed that appellant be released on bail subject to depositing the fine amount, if not already deposited and upon furnishing a personal bond in the sum of Rs. 50,000/- (Rupees Fifty Thousand Only) with solvent surety of the like amount to the satisfaction of the trial Court, with a further direction to appear before the Registry of this Court on 08.05.2025 and on such other dates, as may be fixed by Karamsingh @ Kalu vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 11 March, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/30829817/
